_comment: Lyric lines aligned to the soprano recording. Times are seconds from the start of the file, the same clock as contours.json. Derived by syllable-weighted fitting of the lines to the sung stretches, then confirmed by the singer.
_caveat: Line assignment confirmed; the closing line is NOT repeated. The last two rows have unusual syllable rates simply because the final line is drawn out, so their boundaries are the least precise. Lyrics are a SUPPORTING signal for position finding, never authoritative — an imprecise boundary costs a little speed, never a wrong entry.

lines.text: Sa simoy at sa langit mong bughaw
Lupa ng araw ng luwalhati't pagsinta
Buhay ay langit sa piling mo
Ang mamatay ng dahil sa iyo
